column1: # Bloom's shared lexicon: how the voice says what the text shows, for every voice and every video.
# One shown<TAB>spoken per line; the longest match wins. Add with: bloom lexicon add --shared "<shown>" "<spoken>"
# Keep each fix's reason on a comment line above it.
# ไฟล์ was read as "five" or ไฟล้ (OmniVoice); said as ไฟ, the same sound.
